name: Shangrila Resort & Lower Kachura Lake
description: Famous lakeside resort area with a clear blue lake surrounded by orchards and mountains.

name: Upper Kachura Lake
description: Quiet alpine lake above Lower Kachura with calm water and mountain views.

name: Satpara Lake
description: Large lake near Skardu that supplies the city with water; popular day trip.

name: Deosai National Park
description: High-altitude plateau known for wildflowers, Himalayan brown bears and huge open landscapes.

name: Sheosar Lake
description: Large high-altitude lake inside Deosai plains with dramatic mountain reflections.

name: Kharpocho (Skardu) Fort
description: Historic fort above Skardu town with city and Indus River views.

name: Sarfaranga (Katpana) Cold Desert
description: High-altitude cold desert with dunes beside the Indus River near Skardu.

name: Manthokha Waterfall
description: Popular waterfall in Kharmang area reached from the Skardu side.

name: Basho Valley
description: Green valley with forests, streams and village life, used as a base for treks.

name: Shigar Fort (Fong Khar)
description: Restored historic fort and palace turned into a heritage hotel and museum.

name: Shigar Valley
description: Wide fertile valley on the road to Askole with orchards and mountain scenery.

name: Khaplu Palace (Khaplu Fort)
description: Restored palace of the Khaplu rulers, now a heritage hotel and cultural site.

name: Chaqchan Mosque
description: One of the oldest mosques in the region with traditional wooden architecture.

name: Khaplu Valley
description: Green valley with orchards, old houses and views of the Shyok River area.

name: Hushe Valley
description: Last village before Masherbrum trekking routes, with big mountain views.

name: Masherbrum Base Camp Trek
description: Multi-day trek from Hushe towards the base of Masherbrum.

name: K2 Base Camp / Baltoro Glacier Trek
description: Famous long trek from Askole through the Baltoro Glacier to Concordia and K2 views.

name: Askole Village
description: Last permanent village on the Baltoro/Biafo trekking routes.

name: Biafo Glacier Trek
description: Long glacier trek from Askole towards Snow Lake and Hispar route.

name: Chogo Lungma Glacier / Arandu Trek
description: Remote glacier trek from Arandu village with fewer tourists than Baltoro.

name: Chutron Hot Springs
description: Natural hot springs on the Shigar valley route.

name: Buddha Rock (Manthal)
description: Ancient rock carvings of Buddha and other figures near Skardu.

name: Skardu Main Bazaar
description: Main market for local food, dry fruits, handicrafts and trekking supplies.

name: Rondu Valley
description: Narrow Indus valley section on the Skardu to Gilgit route with villages and views.

name: Kharmang Valley
description: Remote Indus valley area with traditional villages along the river.

name: Shyok River Viewpoints (Khaplu side)
description: River viewpoints and riverside spots around the Khaplu area.

name: Machulu Village
description: Traditional village area near Khaplu with local culture and mountain scenery.
